purpose: Trace GSP writes into the descriptor records consumed by the PIXBLT text path.

records.status: descriptor payload continuation; preceding record header at 0xFFFEA7D0

observations.record_shape: The text records use 16-byte word address stride; words 2/3 form the A1 seed as high/low halfwords, and words 4–7 are packed low-byte/high-byte descriptor payloads.
observations.producer_timing: The records are written at frame 1788, before descriptor reads and PIXBLT writes at frames 1793/1797.
observations.semantic_boundary: Header values such as 0x4013 and 0x4011 are preserved as mechanism-level fields; no general semantic field names are assigned.

interpretation: This is the first direct producer-to-consumer evidence for the text path: GSP writer PCs populate an 8-word record, and the later reader consumes its word-4 descriptor payload while using words 2/3 as the cursor. The writer routine family and header semantics remain to be reconstructed.
